description: This file defines two PyTorch neural network modules, Flatten and Unflatten, used for reshaping tensors within neural network models.

classes.name: Flatten
classes.description: A module that flattens a range of dimensions into a single dimension.

classes.name: Unflatten
classes.description: A module that unflattens a specific dimension of a tensor into multiple dimensions.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Executes the forward pass, applying flatten or unflatten operation.

methods.name: extra_repr
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the module's configuration.
